avis.texte: This is a very effective K beauty niacinamide product for a great price. I've used another niacinamide only product that had increased in price so I did a lot of research and found this through dermatologist Dr. Dray's recommendation. It has a watery consistency that is easy to pat on by itself but I like to apply this nightly by mixing a few drops in with another lightweight serum and spreading over my face and neck. It definitely helps with dark sun spots but my favorite benefit is how much smaller it makes my pores appear. It is bright pink because of the addition of B12, which calms the skin. The addition of tranexamic acid is a nice bonus too. I do not have sensitive skin so I like as high a percentage of active ingredient as possible and I have no irritation whatsoever with this. It's a winner!
Use it every morning for couple of months and you'll see your pigmentation disappear
The product is decent overall, though it feels too watery and doesn't appear to fully absorb into the skin.
